method: normalised MOLIT name match against OSM highway ways named *지하차도*; only when no in-province primary match exists, fall back to exact Korean name aliases on OSM tunnel=yes ways; same-name ways within 2 km averaged and candidates outside a coarse province bbox rejected
limits: OSM coverage is partial and names may differ from the register (e.g. 교차로 vs 지하차도).
fallback matching checks a province bounding box, not the listed city/district; all coordinates remain monitoring candidates, not verified facility entrances or operational locations.
ambiguous rows (same name in several places) need manual review.
coordinates are way centres, not portals; nearest gauges do not prove a shared basin or upstream influence.
